title: PvP Duel
description:
Adds a Duel button to the main menu: two players fight each other, built on the game's own co-op lobby.

Host: Duel > Host. Other player: Duel > type the host's IP (LAN, Hamachi or ZeroTier) > Join. Pick characters, start, and the run opens straight into the duel. The enemy is the other player, with their real HP, block and powers; turns are simultaneous like co-op. When a player dies, both see Victory/Defeat.

Both players need the same game version and the same mod list. The host needs UDP port 33771 open. Duel runs are not saved.

Source and instructions: https://github.com/uilianks/sts-pvp
